The first `flex` string is serialized as a FlexBuffer string with `len = 20`. `CreateBlob()` pushes a `Value` whose `min_bit_width_` is `WidthU(20) == BIT_WIDTH_8`, so this storage expects a 1-byte size prefix.
No equivalent string is in the pool yet, so the first string's `(offset,len)` pair is recorded in `string_pool`. This short, 1-byte-prefixed entry becomes the later dedup target.
